upward-propagation-plan.argument: link_admin's own minting invariant turned out to depend on a uniqueness guarantee redirector's lookup table doesn't actually enforce at the database level.
upward-propagation-plan.upstream_scope: Add a unique index on the links table's short_code column, closing the gap between the invariant and what Postgres enforces.
upward-propagation-plan.downstream_scope: link_admin's own minting retries on a uniqueness violation instead of assuming a clash can't happen.
